analyzed_vuln.description: PackChunkyBytes assumes T_CHANNELS(OutputFormat) is nonzero in its zero-extra/SWAPFIRST rearrangement. For a format with nChan == 0, Extra == 0, and SwapFirst == 1, `nChan - 1` underflows as cmsUInt32Number to UINT32_MAX and is passed to memmove at cmspack.c:1724, producing the negative-size-param report and an enormous out-of-bounds move. Transform creation accepts this malformed format because PT_ANY bypasses the colorspace check and the generic 1-byte output formatter masks ANYCHANNELS, so the unsafe assumption must be guarded (or zero-channel formats rejected before formatter use).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The harness takes attacker-controlled little-endian srcFormat and dstFormat from the first 8 input bytes, opens the following 512 bytes as an ICC source profile, creates an sRGB destination transform, then transforms one pixel. In this PoV dstFormat is 0x00204001: 1 byte/sample, PT_ANY, T_CHANNELS=0, T_EXTRA=0, T_SWAPFIRST=1 (with the optimized bit also set). A profile that successfully opens and links to sRGB allows cmsCreateTransform to select PackChunkyBytes; cmsDoTransform then invokes it and the unsigned `0 - 1` length reaches memmove.

args: Analyze the zero-channel vulnerability in PackChunkyBytes in lcms/src/cmspack.c, especially the Extra == 0 && SwapFirst rearrangement. What is the smallest root-cause fix that preserves semantics, and are there analogous underflows in nearby C/C++ packers that should be fixed consistently? Also explain whether rejecting zero-channel formats centrally is compatible with PT_ANY/ANYCHANNELS intended behavior.

The supplied ASan report says dstFormat 0x00204001 selects PackChunkyBytes with nChan=0, Extra=0, SwapFirst=1. At lcms/src/cmspack.c around line 1724, nChan - 1 underflows to UINT32_MAX and is passed to memmove, causing negative-size-param during cmsDoTransform. The harness controls input/output format words, opens an embedded profile, creates a transform, and transforms one pixel. I have not edited anything yet. I want to identify all nearby variants and avoid merely matching the known PoV; likely options are guarding rearrangement on nChan > 0 or rejecting malformed zero-channel format during formatter selection.
